traps.wrong: A manufactured cold plate was measured to reduce temperature by 18 degrees, or its operating efficiency is proven.
traps.truth: An 18 degree Celsius reduction is a simulation result at one specified load and flow condition. No thermal bench result exists.

traps.wrong: The redesigned cold plate is manufactured, pressure-tested or in production.
traps.truth: Only a polymer fit-check model exists. The metal prototype has not been made or pressure-tested.

traps.wrong: She holds a granted patent or is the sole inventor.
traps.truth: An application is filed, not granted, and names three inventors. Her contribution is the channel manifold and assembly interface.

traps.wrong: The employer's dimensioned CAD or supplier drawings can be published without asking.
traps.truth: Those drawings are confidential. Only the approved external render and a new dimension-free schematic can be shown.
